sections.overview: The Eurasian eagle-owl is a large owl of Europe and Asia.
sections.identification: Orange eyes, feather tufts and mottled brown plumage are distinctive.
sections.habitat: It occupies varied landscapes and often nests on cliffs or sheltered ledges.
sections.diet: It takes mammals and birds, as well as other locally available prey.
sections.behavior: It is mainly active at dusk and night, when its territorial calls can carry far.
sections.reproduction: It lays in a sheltered site, often on a cliff ledge or directly on the ground.
sections.ecology: Its broad prey range makes it a top predator in many habitats.
sections.conservation: BirdLife International lists Bubo bubo as Least Concern globally, while regional populations can face different pressures.
